claim: ValTest uses semantic entropy to classify LLM-generated tests as valid or invalid, raising test validity by up to 29% and improving pass@1 downstream.
stance_target: L4 self-written test adequacy has prior uncertainty-based filtering
quoted_support: VALTEST not only boosts test validity by up to 29% but also improves code generation performance, as evidenced by significant increases in pass@1 scores.

breadth.confidence_families: semantic entropy and token-probability features over LLM-generated test cases, ML classifier of test validity (abstract)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: GPT-4o and GPT-3.5-turbo test generators, o3-mini mentioned; Reflexion agent downstream
breadth.benchmarks: HumanEval, MBPP, LeetCode, BigCodeBench, TestEval (Sec V)
breadth.label_source: test validity via execution against reference/ground truth (Sec V)
breadth.contamination_split: residual contamination discussed as threat (Sec VI)
breadth.calibration_metrics: validity rate, pass@1; AUROC of validity prediction not located
